mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 51 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail, feeling more like 45 degrees as we start our morning.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz issued a proclamation to thank our Planning and Development Department for their dedication to improving our local housing and land use. Also, please note that Highway M will be closed near the future Aldi site from October 6 through October 9 for road work.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival are both happening on October 4.
Regarding local safety, on September 21, police identified a retail theft suspect who had stolen candy from a local store after reviewing surveillance footage.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so you can grab a scoop early.
